_readme: Map points. Coordinates are approximate town/site centers (draft, to verify). figure = node id in graph.json.

places.name: Madurai
places.what: Uncle's house, scene of the 1896 awakening

places.name: Dakshineswar
places.what: Kali temple where he lived and taught

places.name: Mysore
places.what: Yoga school at the Jaganmohan Palace

places.name: Mumbai (Khetwadi)
places.what: The small loft where he received visitors

places.name: Vrindavan
places.what: Where he lived before sailing to America

places.name: Vadalur
places.what: Sathya Gnana Sabha, hall of light

places.name: Aruvippuram
places.what: Shiva consecration on the Neyyar, Shivaratri 1888

places.name: Dakshineswar Kali Temple
places.what: Priest from 1856; all his sadhanas and teaching years, 1855–1885

places.name: Cossipore garden house (Udyanbati)
places.what: Last months and death, 11 Dec 1885 – 16 Aug 1886

places.name: Vivekananda's birthplace, 3 Gourmohan Mukherjee Street, Calcutta
places.what: Birthplace (1863); now the Ramakrishna Mission's ancestral house and cultural centre

places.name: Thousand Island Park, New York
places.what: Summer classes, about seven weeks in 1895 (Inspired Talks); Vivekananda Cottage

places.name: Khetri, Rajasthan
places.what: Court of his patron Raja Ajit Singh (visits 1891 and 1893), who by most accounts suggested the name Vivekananda

places.name: Shimoga (Shivamogga), Karnataka
places.what: Ten days of silence near the Bhadra river, origin of the Sudarshan Kriya (1982), by his own account

places.name: Art of Living International Centre, Kanakapura Road, Bengaluru
Yamuna floodplain near DND Flyway, Delhi
Kankhal, Haridwar
places.what: Kripalu Bagh Ashram: sannyasa (early 1990s); Divya Yog Mandir Trust founded (1995)

places.name: Ramlila Maidan, Delhi
places.what: Hunger strike against corruption, cleared by police on the night of 4-5 June 2011

places.name: Vivekananda's birthplace, 3 Gourmohan Mukherjee Street (now 105 Vivekananda Road), Calcutta
places.what: Birthplace (1863); now the Ramakrishna Mission Swami Vivekananda's Ancestral House and Cultural Centre (opened 2004)

places.name: Ishwar Ashram, Ishber (above Gupta Ganga, near Nishat Bagh)
places.what: His house from 1934 and Ishwar Ashram, overlooking Dal Lake.

places.name: Harvan
places.what: Danyahama, where he studied with Maheshwar Nath Razdan.

places.name: Varanasi (Banaras)
places.what: Sanskrit and philosophical study from c. 1906.

places.name: Radhanagar
places.what: Birthplace (1772 or 1774), near Khanakul, Hooghly district

places.name: Murshidabad
places.what: Clerk to the Company; Tuhfat-ul-Muwahhidin published here c. 1804

places.name: Rangpur
places.what: Dewan to John Digby, c. 1809–1814; discussions on the unity of God

places.name: Kolkata (Chitpore Road, Brahmo Sabha)
places.what: Settled 1814; Atmiya Sabha 1815; Brahmo Sabha 1828, Chitpore Road building under the 1830 trust deed

places.name: Arnos Vale Cemetery, Bristol
places.what: Reburial 29 May 1843 under the chhatri funded by Dwarkanath Tagore; died at Stapleton nearby, 27 September 1833

places.name: Mathura
places.what: Study with Virjananda, c. 1860–1863 (arrival 1859 or 1860 in different sources)

places.name: Anand Bagh, Varanasi
places.what: Kashi shastrartha on image worship, 16 November 1869 (Sarda; some secondary sources give 22 October) (city-level coordinates)

places.name: Navlakha Mahal, Udaipur
places.what: Revision of Satyarth Prakash, 1882–83 (Navlakha Mahal stands in Gulab Bagh)

places.name: Ajmer
places.what: Death at the Bhinai House, 30 October 1883

places.name: Kalavai
places.what: Made 68th head of the monastery, 13 February 1907 (formal installation followed at Kumbakonam, 9 May 1907); samadhis of his two predecessors; golden jubilee 1957.

places.name: Kumbakonam
places.what: The monastery's base during his youth; studied there from about 1909.

places.name: Chengalpattu (Chingleput)
places.what: Met Paul Brunton, January 1931, and sent him to Ramana Maharshi.

places.name: Varanasi
places.what: Reached on 6 October 1934 during the 1919-1939 all-India tour; visited Banaras Hindu University February 1935.

places.name: Kanchi Kamakoti Peetham, Kanchipuram
places.what: First entered as head 25 January 1931; died and buried here, 8-9 January 1994.

places.name: United Nations Headquarters, New York
places.what: His hymn Maithreem Bhajata sung by M. S. Subbulakshmi, 23 October 1966.

places.name: Ramna, Dhaka
places.what: Shahbagh years and the Ramna ashram (1929)

places.name: Kishenpur, Dehradun
places.what: Ashram where Bholanath (1938) and she (1982) died

places.name: Jayrambati
places.what: Birthplace, 1853; her home village for much of her life

places.name: Udbodhan (Mayer Bari), Baghbazar, Kolkata
places.what: Her Calcutta home from 23 May 1909 until her death in 1920

places.name: Gujranwala
places.what: Born at Muraliwala, a village near Gujranwala, 1873

places.name: Vedanta Society of New York
places.what: Minister and spiritual leader since January 2017

places.name: Panni Gali, Agra
places.what: Birthplace and home; public satsang from 1861; died here 1878

places.name: Hathras
places.what: Home of Tulsi Sahib, his family's teacher

places.name: Phoenix Settlement, Inanda
places.what: First community, founded 1904 after reading Ruskin

places.name: Gandhi Smriti (Birla House), New Delhi
places.what: Prayer ground where he was killed, 30 January 1948

places.name: King's College, Cambridge
places.what: Classics scholar 1890–1892; First in Part One of the Classical Tripos, May 1892

places.name: Vadodara (Baroda)
places.what: Baroda State service and Baroda College 1893–1906; silent-mind experience with Lele, January 1908

places.name: Alipore, Kolkata
places.what: Alipore jail and sessions court, May 1908 to 6 May 1909

places.name: Chandannagar (Chandernagore)
places.what: In hiding in the French enclave, February to March 1910

places.name: Auroville (Matrimandir)
places.what: Township founded by the Mother, inaugurated 28 February 1968

places.name: Theosophical Society, Adyar, Chennai
places.what: Where Leadbeater noticed him on the beach, 1909

places.name: Pine Cottage, Ojai, California
places.what: The 1922 experience and the start of the process; his home; died here 1986

places.name: Rishi Valley
places.what: First of his schools; land acquired from 1926

places.name: Castle Eerde, Ommen
places.what: Star Camp where he dissolved the Order of the Star, 3 August 1929

places.name: Brockwood Park, Hampshire
places.what: School founded 1969; home of the Krishnamurti Foundation Trust

places.name: Jorasanko Thakur Bari, Kolkata
places.what: Tagore family house; birthplace (1817) and place of death (1905)

places.name: Santiniketan, Bolpur
places.what: Land leased 1863; ashram trust deed 8 March 1888; Upasana Mandir 1891

places.name: Belgharia, near Kolkata
places.what: Garden house where Ramakrishna first met him, 1875

places.name: Bhide Wada, Pune
places.what: Site traditionally given for the Phules' first girls' school, 1848

places.name: Phule Wada, Ganj Peth, Pune
places.what: The Phules' home, now a memorial

places.name: Sandeepany Sadhanalaya, Powai, Mumbai
places.what: Residential Vedanta school opened 1963; VHP founding meeting August 1964; Dayananda taught here

places.name: Sidhbari
places.what: Samadhi shrine at the mission's ashram near Dharamshala

places.name: Rishikesh
places.what: Arsha Vidya Pitham; died here 23 September 2015
